declarations.type:
∀ (candidates : List ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate)
  (rank : ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate → Nat),
  (∀ (removed witness : ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate),
      ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.findDominator candidates removed = some witness →
        rank witness < rank removed) →
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate),
      rank current < fuel →
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteBoundedDominanceWitnessChain.resolveWitnessChain candidates fuel current).status =
          ASPProof.SearchRouteBoundedDominanceWitnessChain.ResolutionStatus.retained
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCapacityRankCertificate.rank_bounded_resolution_is_retained

declarations.type:
∀ (candidates : List ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteCapacityRankCertificate.CapacityRankCertificate candidates)
  (start : ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate),
  start ∈ candidates →
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteBoundedDominanceWitnessChain.resolveWitnessChain candidates candidates.length start).status =
      ASPProof.SearchRouteBoundedDominanceWitnessChain.ResolutionStatus.retained
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCapacityRankCertificate.capacity_fuel_is_not_exhausted

declarations.type:
∀ (candidates : List ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteCapacityRankCertificate.CapacityRankCertificate candidates)
  (start : ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.Candidate),
  start ∈ candidates →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteFiniteMultiobjectiveParetoMaskWitness.keepCandidate candidates
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteBoundedDominanceWitnessChain.resolveWitnessChain candidates candidates.length
            start).endpoint =
      true
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCapacityRankCertificate.capacity_fuel_reaches_kept_endpoint
